reviews.title: Custom Fit
reviews.comment: It fits tightly, which is why there are some bad reviews; however, if you push it on and then pull gently all around, little by little, it goes on just fine.  It is thin, which I think makes it less muffling for a crisper sound.
reviews.author: S. R. Miller

reviews.title: It fits perfect, I don’t understand all the bad reviews
reviews.comment:
I was skeptical of buying this because of the bad reviews. But for $8, it was worth a shot.
It fits perfectly on the NT-USB+
I think the problem with the bad reviews is, they simply haven’t stretched the filter down far enough. It definitely is a tight fit and takes some work to get it fully over the mic, but looks great once it’s on and isn’t going anywhere!
Love it. 10/10 would recommend for the NT-USB+.
reviews.author: Nick Fitchpatrick

reviews.title: It Fit very well, and was easy to install
reviews.comment:
The Rode NT USB Microphone Windscreen fit my Rode NT USB Microphone very well. I had no issues what so ever installing it on the microphone, it took 1 minute and 40sec to install, I was careful with it, and after testing its doing what it's supposed to.
I'm happy with it, however would consider it better priced at $5.99 rather then $8.99 it's not high quality. I'll most likely have to purchase another such item during the life of the microphone.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Not "Specially Designed", Dimensions are Wrong
reviews.comment:
This cover was definitely, 100% not "specially designed" for the Rode NT-USB. It was made for a longer, thinner, microphone with a ROUND end (not oval and flat).
It's fine if this was marketed as a universal microphone cover, but it's completely dishonest to say this was specially designed for the Rode NT-USB unless someone just measured all the dimensions inaccurately.
The foam hole is too small and it tears slightly in order to fit the NT-USB inside. The resulting fit has the foam material stretched extremely, extremely tight meaning that as it ages it's going to fall apart quickly. Plus, there is a pocket of unused material at the end to accommodate a round tip, which the Rode NT-USB does not have. This is not "specially designed".
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.comment: Cheap material and fit. Rips quite easily as you struggle to get it on. Literally going in the garbage.
